documents.name: PostRegistrationLetterWithPaymentInstructions
documents.content:
Dear <<Registration:FirstName>> and Parents of <<Registration:FirstName>>,

You have successfully registered for this season's <<League>>.

Don't forget to send in your signed Medical Waiver. No player can practice or play

until their Medical Waiver has been received.

If you haven't already paid online, please send a check for $<<SignupFeeForIndividual>> payable to "Dirt Bowl".

Both the payment and the waiver can be mailed to the following address:

<<League>>

<<AdminAdrss>>

<<AdminsCity>><<AdminState>>, <<AdminsZIP>>

If you need any information about the season, you can always look at our Web site

at http://www.dirtbowl.com. For dealing with personal information like reviewing or

changing your registration info, checking your team roster or schedule and the like,

use the link below. This is your personal link. Do not share it with others.

Here it is: <<Registration:RegID>>

To save this link, click on it. A Dirt Bowl Web page will come up, your personal page.

Saving this link depends upon which browser you use:

If you use Internet Explorer, click on "Favorites" in the Menu Bar at top and

then "Add to Favorites."

If you use Firefox, click on "Bookmarks" in the Menu Bar at top and then

"Bookmark this Page."

If you use Safari, click on "Bookmarks" and then "Add Bookmarks."

You'll get your team roster and schedule by email once they've been completed, but

they will also always be available to you on your Dashboard.

I'm looking forward to seeing you at the Dirt Bowl games this season!

Yours,

<<AdminName>>

Preseason Activities

Back to Administrator Dashboard


Recruitment List Tools


Assign Players to Teams



Player Registration Tools


Order Jerseys



Set up Teams and Coaches


Send Dashboards to Coaches


The Recruitment List Tools allow you to maintain an email list of potential prospects for your

League. You can add, edit and delete names from the list, audit the email addresses for

validity and send bulk mailings out to this list inviting them to register for your league.

The Player Registration Tools allow you to register a player or a group for your league, edit

or delete player registrations, mark receipt of waivers and payments, audit email addresses

and send bulk messages out to the players and their families. You can use this tool to send

reminders to those with incomplete registrations as well as to send personal Player dashboards

to those who have lost theirs.

The Set up Teams and Coaches link lets to add, edit or delete team names, gather contact

information on your coaches, and assign coaches to individual teams.

You may use the Assign Players to Teams link to move players onto teams using a drag-

and-drop tool that lets you see basic player information, such as sex, age and friends.

The Order Jerseys link will give you size breakouts for jerseys for all of your registered players.

If you use divisions, it will break them out by division.

The final link, Send Dashboards to Coaches, permits you to send out a bulk mailing to all of

your coaches, giving them their team assignments and providing each with a personal Coach's

Dashboard with a set of tools to help them manage their team.

Edit a recruitment record




Delete a recruitment record






You can manage records in the Recruitment List both here and on the Tawala Website in your MyProjects <<League>> Project Detail Page. The recruitment list is called "RecruitmentDB." It is easier to delete records from the Web page, and you can also import contact lists there. To import, try clicking on the import icon () to the right of "RecruitmentDB" file name and select an Excel or .csv file to import. The file must have the correct information in these five fields: Child's First Name, Last Name, Parent's First Name, Parent's Email address, Phone.

documents.content:
Player Registration Management

Back to Preseason SetupBack to Administrator Dashboard

Register a Player or Group

View all registrations

Audit registration email addresses

Mark waivers and payments

View/Edit a specific registration

Communicate with registered players


Delete a registration





In Register a Player or Group, you may enter registration information directly, send someone a direct link to the registration form for them to fill out, or do a group registration.

You may use Mark waivers and payments to record the receipt of registration fees and medical waivers. You may also unmark any items that were previously marked in error.

You may use View all registrations to access several summary view of all the registrations forms. You may sort any view by the responses in any column just by clicking on the heading for that column.

View/Edit a specific registration permits you to access any player's registration form in order to view it or correct information.

Delete a registration is useful to remove a record entirely. The is especially valuable when registrants inadvertently end up with duplicate records in the database.

Audit registration email addresses checks the addresses in all the registrations for validity. It can catch common typos and misspellings, although it doesn't catch everything.

With Communicate with registered players, you are able to send bulk mailings to all players, to those missing waivers, to those who have not yet paid and to those whose registrations are complete in all respects.
